observationsNotFindings: The two-word phrase 'Wave 2 sample.' opens the rationale and has no referent anywhere in live COORD. It would enter the durable record verbatim on adoption, and a later reader would find no definition of Wave 2. I declined to charge it because it touches none of the operative text and asserts nothing checkable about governance state — the same reasoning by which I have declined inert denials and historical-tense roles elsewhere in this corpus. But it is the coordinator's record, and if wave labelling is meant to be traceable it wants a definition somewhere in COORD or removal from the entry. Flagging rather than charging.

D-163 is a better-chosen precedent than it first appears. It records permission-leftover-join.v2 as a DR-105 leftover measurement — the same artifact family and the same register row as this entry — so the class claim is corroborated not just by shape but by a direct ancestor of this very chain. D-170, the other cited precedent, is the same class one row over.

Item 2 is the sentence that matters and it holds the split. v9's substantive result is that actor-join execution became qualification at a live gate while authoring and integration stayed leftover-design on another row; a recording entry could easily state the first half and let it read as a discharge. This one states the qualification, then the five remaining obligations, then 'Naming is not execution. Not QUALIFIED.' in three consecutive sentences.
